verification_method.source_phase_boundaries: Actual step-20 source log through its unique final aggregate; protected receipt and loopback are parsed separately.
verification_method.verdict_parsing: Accept PASS/FAIL suffixes attached to pytest progress, including .PASS; do not require start of line and do not accept BYPASS. Capture all selectors, including bootstrap paths.
verification_method.case_parsing: Capture every CASE_START path.py::Class::function or path.py::function, including markers attached to progress; normalize path separators without normalizing test identities.
verification_method.protected_counter: For every frozen protected module, compare the whole oracle function Counter after multiplication by the number of selecting workflow file/directory entries. Also require the exact individual module verdict count.
verification_method.counter_hash_encoding: SHA256 of compact JSON object with lexicographically sorted keys and integer values, encoded as UTF-8.
